notes.title: PERFECT PLAN - 2025 MAJOR UPDATE!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28280061/49ab563de9e5576f1d68f3242192f31f2a208f49.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello everyone, [b]Amirulradzi[/b] here![/p][p]We're excited to release a major update for [b]PERFECT PLAN[/b], a stylized first-person boomer shooter with an uncapped health bar! This update introduces new features, reworks major boss fights, improves balance, and fixes several bugs.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28280061/bfecd41c9235d95b8e2f7d9fa39280f3bf8505db.gif"][/img] [/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Feature: Level Selection[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Now accessible from the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Replay previous levels to collect missed weapons or shield upgrades and any boss you've already defeated.[/p][/*][*][p]Increase your overall health count to defeat the final boss.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28280061/1d50154b3ea797ce941e8cafe762f15ca61e1fb3.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Boss and Enemy Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Octogen (BANK boss) now has new attack animations and a second phase.[/p][/*][*][p]The Fat Factory boss includes additional attack patterns and appears in two encounters.[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple bosses and enemy attack patterns have been reworked for improved challenge and pacing.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]New Mechanic: Shield Gates[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Shield-powered gates have been added to certain levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Use the Shield Launcher to destroy gate power sources and unlock blocked paths.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28280061/325a3eea6ee905b47bd2e3ec07f5a145eb8dc5f7.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]All In Statues[/b][/h3][list][*][p]More Coin Statues have been hidden across levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Trade all your coins at these statues to restore health supremacy.[/p][/*][*][p]Several levels have undergone major design changes too.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay Balance Adjustments[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Increased weapon damage to make combat faster and more impactful.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased damage received to reduce "bullet sponge" gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Health pickup costs have been adjusted to match the new balance.[/p][/*][*][p]All bosses now include intro voice lines.[/p][/*][*][p]Select enemies now have unique audio effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a brightness slider to the Options menu for better visual clarity. Real reason: I was testing the game on my little bro’s new monitor and couldn’t see shit![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where picking up a gun upgrade before unlocking the weapon caused errors; now upgrades and unlocks properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved level travel issues related to the Stolen Key; key detachment now only occurs at intended levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where explosives stayed armed after exiting to the main menu, which could soft-lock progress in trap levels.[/p][/*][/list][h3]
[/h3][previewyoutube="w56x19HzVfo;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]
[/h3][h3][b]Thank You! [/b][/h3][p]Thank you for playing and supporting [b]PERFECT PLAN[/b]. We hope you enjoy all the new content and improvements in this update. If you haven't yet, please consider adding the game to your wishlist.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/605160/Perfect_Plan/"][/dynamiclink]If you're enjoying the game, please leave a review, tell us your favorite boss, and how many times you died! It really helps![/p][p][/p][p] Follow us on YouTube, Instagram, Twitter, Threads, and TikTok for the latest updates and future game development progress.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Perfect Plan 2023: Major Update and Remake for a Classic Shooter – Now for All!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce a monumental update for Perfect Plan, the game that quietly made its debut in 2017. Now, after six years of dedicated development, the creators of Perfect Plan are back and ready to redefine your gaming experience in 2023. Please try our latest update and check out the ladder, green glowing ladder.

[previewyoutube=KfT9oExmuxA;full][previewyoutube=v620_cNva68;full][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Fresh Graphics, Enhanced Immersion[/h2]

Prepare to be awed by the breathtaking new graphics in Perfect Plan 2023 Update. We've completely overhauled the visual aesthetics of the game, immersing you in a world that feels more vivid, dynamic, and Stylized than ever before. This is not just an update; it's a reimagining of your favorite game that will make you fall in love with it all over again. 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/605160/extras/PerfectPlan_2023_GameplayGif__4_.gif?t=1699207411[/img]

[h2]Uncapped Health for Unstoppable Action[/h2]

Ever felt limited by your health bar? Say goodbye to those restrictions! In Perfect Plan 2023 Update, we've introduced an exciting change - uncapped health. You can now dive headfirst into the action, taking on enemies without the worry of being defeated. It's your time to shine, invincible and unstoppable.

I beat the final boss with 1400000+ health. - Amirulradzi, Main Dev.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/605160/extras/PerfectPlan_2023_GameplayGif__1_.gif?t=1699207411[/img]

[h2]Deployable Shields for Tactical Domination[/h2]

Perfect Plan 2023 Update takes strategy to a whole new level with deployable shields. Launch these defensive barriers directly at your foes, turning the tide of battle in your favor. Think on your feet, adapt to the situation, and protect yourself like never before. It's a game-changer that adds a whole new layer of depth to your tactical choices.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/605160/extras/PerfectPlan_2023_GameplayGif__2_.gif?t=1699207411[/img]

[h2]Nail-Biting Platforming Adventures[/h2]

Remember the thrilling moments of leaping from ladder to ladder? Perfect Plan 2023 Update reintroduces these adrenaline-pumping platforming sequences. Hone your platforming skills and feel the rush as you jump, climb, and swing your way through challenging levels. The stakes are higher, and the rewards are greater than ever.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/605160/ss_a4422426597ffb91b1b050328c95a4c8f3b5f89f.1920x1080.jpg?t=1699207411[/img]

[h2]A Heartfelt Apology from the Developers[/h2]

To all our loyal players, we owe you an apology for the game's initial obscurity. We want to express our gratitude to the community that's supported Perfect Plan throughout the years. It's your enthusiasm and love for the game that motivated us to craft this incredible update. We hope you'll give it another try and experience the passion and dedication we've poured into Perfect Plan 2023 Update. Your enjoyment is what makes our day, and we can't wait to share this new adventure with you.

Perfect Plan 2023 Update is more than just an update; it's a grand reimagining of a hidden gem. Come back to Perfect Plan in 2023, and let's make gaming history together, one thrilling adventure at a time.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/605160/ss_ece47a13fc7796a6376537c4adc516a0e90dafc5.600x338.jpg?t=1699207411[/img]

Tips for the developer:

"If your health is critically low, consider restarting the level, as progressing with low health can lead to increased vulnerability and potential progression issues in the next stage." - Somebody.

Please hold onto your coins in the trains station, you might need it at that final moment. maybe you do, maybe not, idk. - Amirulradzi, Main Dev.

notes.title: New Update is Coming to Perfect Plan
notes.content:
New big update will come to Perfect Plan in February 2018 . The update will be available to all Perfect Plan owner in early february 2018 and making it Perfect Plan 1.1  . 



[list]
    [*]New Content for Perfect Plan. Adding 11 new level to be play separetely from the main story .

    [*]Fixed shotgun and sniper bug . Bullet will no longer be stuck in the mid air, not loaded and stuck forever . 

    [*]Fixed unresponsive weapon pickup system .  

    [*]Fixed many level bug and level loading bug .

    [*]More information about gameplay guide . 

    [*]Fixed texture loading issue . 

    [*]Updated Material for Mining camp maps . Making glowing rock more beautiful .

    [*]updated material for enemies props . Adding more texture and glowing material to enemies props .

    [*]Fixed unecessary file and data making the game file smaller but will not be noticeble as the update will increase the file size back .

    [*]increased weapon change animation, weapon change delay, weapon reload delay and weapon reload animation . Add weapon bullet count to player HUD.
[/list]
